n.story:
Your role is transforming into that of a high-tech quality strategist. While the tactile 'feel' of premium leather still requires your expert touch, AI-powered computer vision and spectral analysis are becoming your new eyes, catching microscopic defects and material inconsistencies that the human eye might miss. You are moving away from manual data entry and basic inspection toward managing 'smart' quality systems that predict failures before they happen. 

Communication across your global supply chain is becoming seamless as real-time AI translation allows you to resolve technical issues with international partners in their native languages instantly. You will spend less time on the factory floor doing repetitive checks and more time using AI-driven insights to reduce the environmental footprint of production. You are becoming the bridge between traditional craftsmanship and data-driven manufacturing excellence, ensuring that technology enhances rather than replaces the heritage of leather working.
